tha-ap351:1.1: Tiṇḍukaphaladāyaka.] Kaṇikāraṃ va jotantaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare / addasaṃ *virajaṃ Buddham oghatiṇ*ṇam anāsavaṃ. // //
tha-ap351:2.1: Tiṇḍukaṃ saphalaṃ disvā bhinditvāna sakoṭakaṃ / pasannacitto sumano Vessabhussa adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap351:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap351:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tiṇḍukaphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
